full_judgment: 34. It is true that the deed of exchange is a registered document. Registration, no doubt, attaches a statutory presumption, which extends to the registration of the deed only. Such presumption is never intended to extend to the genuineness of the transaction or to prove execution and/or recitals in the deed.
